name: axiom
description: Codex engineering with Astra XHIGH planning and advice, Luna MAX Fast workers, Sol MAX design, independent Sol review, and context isolation.

interface.longDescription: Axiom is a guidance-first Codex plugin for non-trivial software engineering. Main (Sol XHIGH) owns intent, architecture, design direction, integration, review adjudication, and final acceptance. Luna MAX Fast handles ordinary bounded work, while Sol MAX handles bounded work with unresolved material visual, interaction, or information-design judgment. Meaningful changes receive a separate fresh Sol XHIGH review with same-reviewer continuity, while context isolation and safe Git coordination protect the main thread and existing user work. Astra XHIGH drafts difficult plans and advises on consequential decisions using selected dialogue and evidence; Main retains adoption and acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $axiom:axiom to implement this change with efficient delegation and independent review.
Use $axiom:axiom to investigate this codebase while keeping Main context concise.
